description: Searches Overflow Design's hand-drawn drawings by what they show: 1,120 icons, 457 illustrations and 71 isometric drawings. Use it when the user wants an icon, an illustration or an isometric drawing. Every word of the query must match a drawing's name or tags, and "icon", "illustration" or "isometric" in the query narrows the search to that set. Returns each match's id, name, set, category and page link, and marks the drawings this connection cannot fetch because they need an Overflow Pro licence.

category.description: Only this category, by its slug or its label.

query.description: What the drawing should show, in plain words. Empty with a set or category to browse it.

tier.description: free for drawings anybody can fetch, pro for the ones that need Pro.

name: search_drawings
